story_arceus_11_01000/2401_1001_100_10:
Aw, man! I lost! Elio and Selene were just
too strong!
story_arceus_11_01000/2401_1001_200_10:
Lillie was amazing, too! I can’t believe you
beat Gladion!
story_arceus_11_01000/2401_1001_500_10:
It was super impressive! But Gladion,
you weren’t focused during your battle!
story_arceus_11_01000/2401_1001_600_10:
Is that what it was? I was wondering why
you left so many openings!
story_arceus_11_01000/2401_1001_700_10: I don’t want to win against you like that!
story_arceus_11_01000/2401_1001_900_10:
You too, Hau! You held back against me and
Selene, didn’t you.
story_arceus_11_01000/2401_1001_1100_10:
After becoming Neo Champions, you two
seemed so busy!
story_arceus_11_01000/2401_1001_1200_10:
It’s been a while since our last battle, and I
was having so much fun...
story_arceus_11_01000/2401_1001_1500_10:
Hau and I weren’t taking our battles
seriously enough.
story_arceus_11_01000/2401_1001_1600_10:
We were supposed to go all out. We’ll do
better next time.
story_arceus_11_01000/2401_1001_1700_10:
We may have won today, but you never
know how the next battle will go!
story_arceus_11_01000/2401_1001_1800_10:
In a competition, the slightest thing can tip
the scale.
story_arceus_11_01000/2401_1001_1900_10: Our top priority is to awaken our arc suits!
story_arceus_11_01000/2401_1001_2000_10:
Yeah! We gotta build even deeper bonds
before the next Arceus Cup.
story_arceus_11_01000/2401_1001_2100_10:
Let’s see who can get Arceus’s
approval first!
story_arceus_11_01000/2401_1001_2200_10: Yes! We’ll do our best—at full power!
story_arceus_11_01000/2401_1001_2400_10: Are you disappointed we lost, Gladion?
story_arceus_11_01000/2401_1001_2700_10:
But obsessing over it won’t make me
stronger.
story_arceus_11_01000/2401_1001_3000_10:
I’m supposed to be Lillie’s protector, but she
grew so strong...
story_arceus_11_01000/2401_1001_3100_10: and she’s got reliable friends by her side.
story_arceus_11_01000/2401_1001_3200_10: So why would I need to be strong?
story_arceus_11_01000/2401_1001_3300_10: There you go complicating things again.
story_arceus_11_01000/2401_1001_3400_10: To be honest, I’ve no clue.
story_arceus_11_01000/2401_1001_3500_10:
Hm... I don’t think this will be easy
to answer.
story_arceus_11_01000/2401_1001_3600_10:
I know! Why don’t we find a reason
together?
story_arceus_11_01000/2401_1001_3800_10:
If we look around, I’m sure we’ll discover
something!
